title: EpixChain v0.7.0 Upgrade: Faster Transactions and Improved Network
summary: This upgrade brings EpixChain up to the latest cosmos/evm release. It introduces faster transaction processing, parallel execution, and updated networking libraries. It also removes an unused module that was carried over from earlier versions. This is a consensus-breaking upgrade. All validators must run the v0.7.0 binary by block 3,925,000.
